scripts.generate: npm run generate:rpc && npm run generate:api
scripts.generate:rpc: uv run python -m browsertunnel.schema_export && uv run python ../scripts/generate_rpc_client.py
scripts.generate:api: uv run python ../scripts/export_openapi_schemas.py && orval && prettier --write generated-backend/src/generated
scripts.check:generated: npm run check:rpc && npm run check:api
scripts.check:rpc: uv run python -m browsertunnel.schema_export && uv run python ../scripts/generate_rpc_client.py --check
scripts.check:api: npm run generate:api && git diff --quiet -- generated-backend/src/generated
